sT3.description: Supplementary sT3 'SNP for target gene': cis-variant BMD instruments (gene +/-2.5 kb, FDR<0.05, clumped r2<0.01) per anti-osteoporosis drug-target gene, exposure effects only. MR results for ESR1 by outcome are in sT5 (endometriosis = ukb-d-N80).

Xiang2024bmd-1.notes: All 87 ESR1 rows of sT3, which the main text names as the instrument table. sT5 reports nsnp=134 for ESR1 on endometriosis (ukb-d-N80; IVW OR 0.9992, rounded 0.99 in the claim) and 128-134 for other outcomes, i.e. more SNPs than sT3 lists, so the supplement's ESR1 list is incomplete or from a different selection step; the 134-SNP set cannot be reconstructed. No outcome effects, so no recompute.
